description: No clean concept found. It is strongest in sparse, early positions where I own the bottom-left corner (0,0) while the opponent holds bottom-row stones at the right edge (col 6) and in cols 1/2 (often stacked), and their stone sits on mine at (2,4); an opponent stone at bottom centre (0,3) suppresses it. It is side-to-move specific and left/right asymmetric. It fades as the centre fills, and many firings fit no simple rule.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes every column's probability by at most 0.04.
notes: 4 of 8 score calls used. p1 their-threat-above-landing-cell F1 0.05 (wrong). p2 additive weights on about 20 (cell, owner) features, chosen from single-cell band histograms and act minimal pairs: F1 0.227, AUROC 0.69, sim share 0.05 (submitted). p3 two-corner rule F1 0.09. p4 gated additive F1 0.22. Strong interactions between stones (3-stone scan: O at c1+c1 1.9 but c1+c2 0.04), mirror positions do not fire, and it fades in late games. This looks like a distributed mixture or a random direction. Synthesis 2,3,6,0,2,3,5 reaches 7.03 against a dev max of 5.53.
